overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation on any of the three allegations (pre-meeting deliberation, minutes, and openness of the March 8 meeting), though it offered guidance on quorum communications and executive session procedure.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board deliberated about a fire chief's age and fitness for the post before its March 8 meeting, outside a properly noticed session.
allegations.key_passage: As the complainant has provided no evidence to suggest improper deliberation, we credit the Board's denial.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to create accurate minutes of the March 8 meeting after the secretary asked whether to keep recording during the discussion.
allegations.key_passage: and these minutes include a summary of the discussion at issue between Mr. Adams and Chief Forgea.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board implied it was entering executive session, constructively excluding the public from an open session on March 8.
allegations.key_passage: On these facts, we conclude that the Board's actions were not sufficient to lead a member of the public to reasonably assume that the open session had concluded, and accordingly decline to find a violation.
